errors.text_span: като най-високата точка е в началото на графиката, приблизително на 800 000 години преди настоящето, със стойност около 260 ppm
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that the highest point (at ~260 ppm) is at the beginning of the graph (800,000 years ago). The actual highest point is at the very end ('Текущо ниво' / 'Current level') with a value of approximately 420 ppm.

errors.text_span: достигащо минимум около 210 ppm преди 500 000 години преди настоящето
errors.evidence: The description states a minimum of around 210 ppm at 500,000 years ago. The data point on the chart at that time is visibly higher, at approximately 230 ppm.

errors.text_span: достигайки високо ниво около 310 ppm преди 10 000 години преди настоящето
errors.evidence: The description mentions a data point at 10,000 years ago with a value of 310 ppm. There is no data point at 10,000 years on the x-axis, and the data point at 0 years (1950) is approximately 280 ppm, not 310 ppm. This information is hallucinated.

errors.text_span: достигайки минимум около 220 ppm преди 100 000 години преди настоящето
errors.evidence: The description states a minimum of 220 ppm at 100,000 years ago, but the chart shows the value is closer to 230 ppm.
